title: Count Nodes Equal to Sum of Descendants
summary: Given a binary tree's root, count nodes whose value equals the sum of their descendants' values, with descendants defined as nodes on the path from a node to any leaf, and a node with no descendants having a sum of 0.
statement: Given a binary tree's root, count nodes whose value equals the sum of their descendants' values, with descendants defined as nodes on the path from a node to any leaf, and a node with no descendants having a sum of 0.
constraints: The tree contains 1 through 100000 nodes with values from -100000 through 100000.
A node matches when its value equals the sum of every strict descendant; a leaf therefore matches exactly when its value is zero.
Return the number of matching nodes.
